subject.title: fix: prevent LINE channel reloads from hanging on stalled deliveries

question: Should LINE reloads preserve exclusive ownership until a stalled active delivery exits, or should maintainers approve and define a cancellation/fencing contract before allowing replacement recovery after a fixed grace period?
rationale: The prior merged review records that releasing ownership before the original handler exits can duplicate side effects; choosing a bounded reload deadline therefore changes the channel's delivery guarantee rather than being a purely mechanical timeout fix.

options.title: Preserve exclusive ownership
options.body: Keep the current wait-for-active-delivery behavior until a safe cancellation or fencing mechanism exists.

options.title: Define bounded abandonment
options.body: Approve a core/channel contract that cancels or fences the old delivery before its queue claim is released, then add proof that late old-handler effects cannot escape.

recommendation.title: Preserve exclusive ownership
recommendation.body: Keep the current wait-for-active-delivery behavior until a safe cancellation or fencing mechanism exists.

likelyOwner.reason: The related merged lifecycle work and this branch both originate from the same recent LINE ingress ownership work.
